k_of_n.quote: Localized renal cell carcinoma that is no more than 4cm in size when either of the following criteria is met:

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Anatomic exclusion as a requirement: 'Tumor is located at least 1 cm from the trachea, main bronchi, esophagus, aorta, aortic arch branches, pulmonary artery and the heart.' Negative evidence: 'There is no evidence of extrapulmonary metastases'. Everything not listed is investigational.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Repeat ablation: 'If repeat ablation is planned, twelve months should have elapsed before a repeat ablation is considered.' (sits in the lung-metastasis list, applicability to the other pathways unclear).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: when either of the following criteria is met: In order to preserve kidney function in members with significantly impaired renal function ...; AND When the standard surgical approach ... is likely to substantially worsen existing kidney function; OR The member is not considered a surgical candidate.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'Either of the following' implies two options, but three bullets are present with an AND between the first two and an OR before the third: reads as (A AND B) OR C, but could also be read as A AND (B OR C).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: RFA is being performed in order to preserve lung function when surgical resection or radiation treatment is likely to substantially worsen pulmonary status OR the member is not considered a surgical candidate; AND There is no evidence of extrapulmonary metastases; AND ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: An OR inside a sentence inside an ALL list: bullet-level AND with in-sentence OR.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Renal cell carcinoma not meeting the criteria above; AND All other tumors outside the liver
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The investigational list ends with 'AND' as a list joiner (meaning 'and also'), not conjunction of criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Palliative treatment of pain in members with osteolytic bone metastases who have failed or are poor candidates for standard treatment such as radiation or opioids, OR
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Top-level OR between indications; 'failed or are poor candidates' is an inner OR.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Four CPT codes (20982, 32998, 50542, 50592) each correspond to one pathway but the document does not map them; a stray CPT descriptor for 32998 is repeated as plain text after the table. LOINC documentation table present.

external_dependencies.what: Liver tumors handled by another policy
external_dependencies.quote: For radiofrequency ablation of liver tumors, refer to Radiofrequency Ablation of Liver Tumors, 02-40000-23.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: a property of a tumor where it is unable to be removed surgically

vague_terms.problem: Partly defined by GFR < 60 or one kidney, but 'significantly' remains.

extraction_hazards: Bullet characters are dropped in the text; the 'OR' / '; AND' line endings are the only separators.
Second-level bullets (the RCC sub-conditions) are indented but with the same glyph; the RCC block is followed by a blank line and the next bullet starts at the original indent.
A stray repeated CPT descriptor (32998) appears as free text after the coding table.
The investigational list ends items with ';' and 'AND' unlike the covered list.
'cm' with no space ('4cm') and 'mL/min/m2' with superscript lost.
interesting_structures: Multi-indication pathway list with per-indication size ceilings and anatomic proximity rules.
Mixed AND/OR at the same level with prose lead-ins like 'either of the following' that disagree with the number of bullets.
Explicit investigational enumeration after criteria (not just 'all other').

fit_to_tree.why: Each pathway is a small tree with numeric leaves, but the RCC AND/OR grouping is ambiguous and several terms ('surgical candidate', 'amenable') need clinician judgment; imaging/path data needed for size and distance.
